diffs.diff: header pin 3: part says PWM, datasheet reading says Signal
diffs.evidence: Label-only difference for the same conductor: both readings put GND, V+ and the control line in the same order with the same roles (gnd, power, io). The vendor sources do not use either label. Adafruit #169 calls it the "orange control wire" and says it carries the pulse ("Position \"0\" (1.5ms pulse) is middle"). TowerPro's SG92R page says only "Servo Plug: JR (Fits JR and Futaba)" and gives no wire names. That control line is a PWM pulse input, so "PWM" and "Signal" name the same orange wire (3rd position, after brown GND and red V+). The wiring and electrical behaviour are the same either way, so the model needs no change.
